page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with marginal notes in the right margin beside the italic quotation. Running head at top, page number at top right. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: Idque quo magis in nobis illa

l.i: Ea quæ in novo testamento à san-
ctis facta sunt, valent ad exempla
in præceptis digesta sunt. Velut cum
percussus esset, non ait: Ecce alte-
ram maxillam, sed ait: si male dixi,
exprobra de malo: si autem bene,
quid me cædis? Vbi ostendit illam

page.notes: Marginal notes are in the right margin: "Auguft. libr.1. de Mendac." beside the first line of the quotation, and "Et deScr-mon. do-mini in mont.lib. 1.c.37." beside "alapâ". The word "legimus" has a blot over it that may hide a letter. The reference marks in the text are not clearly visible. The running head is printed as "De Duéllis." in the scan; I have read it as "De Duellis." The page number is printed as "141" (possibly "14I"). The word "sanctis" at the line break is partly obscured and read from context.
